def place_objects(h,w,objs):
    g=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for color,top,left,mask in objs:
        for dr,line in enumerate(mask):
            for dc,bit in enumerate(line):
                if bit: g[top+dr][left+dc]=color
    return g
mask_a=['.##.','####','####','####','#..#']
